_comment: Environment registry for the DevOps Center data-kit pipeline. `alias` is the sf CLI org alias and is authoritative; usernames/hosts need not match the alias. Update `status` as each is wired: planned -> connected -> verified.

hub.note: Durable DevOps Center Hub org. Work items + pipeline definition live here, AND it is the pipeline's final Production stage (branch main). Chosen over a sandbox because a sandbox refresh resets the Data Cloud tenant and would wipe the control plane. Promoting a data kit to Production deploys it here; Data Cloud is already provisioned in this org (parent prerequisite for sandbox Data Cloud). Appears again in `environments[]` as the Production entry for completeness.

environments.note: Where the file-upload data stream -> DLO -> DMO -> data kit is built. Needs Data Cloud provisioned in the sandbox (credits + manual 'Get Started').

environments.branchNote: Intermediate stage branch, NOT main. Created from main via the DevOps Center 'Add Branch' dialog ('Create a branch from main for this stage'). main belongs to the final stage (Production).
environments.note: Mid promotion stage between Development and Production. Uses the `default` data space, which already exists (nothing to pre-create). The UploadedFiles connection arrived inactive here and had to be activated. After each install, run scripts/deploy-datakit-components.sh and, the first time, Update File.

Final promotion stage. SAME org as `hub` above (afd360-prod) — it is both the control plane and the Production release target. Promoting to main deploys the data kit here; Data Cloud is already provisioned in prod (parent prerequisite for sandbox Data Cloud).

sourceControl.note: DevOps Center creates/owns stage branches (dcstaging1 for Staging, main for Production) and auto-creates WI-00000X work-item branches (no feature/ prefix) off dcstaging1. The only other writer is scripts/commit-datakit-to-work-item.sh, which pushes data-kit source to a WI-* branch.
